game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Stalactite Hall, a hall of dripping stalactites: the lantern keeper must handle slime blobs while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Loop Counter Conveyor: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed.
theme: Shadow Cave – Stalactite Hall: a hall of dripping stalactites
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
